payload.summary: MAR-2926 and MAR-2929: tests must not depend on process-creation timing or file-time resolution; make every simulated concurrent change observable explicitly.
lessons: taskkill /T snapshots the process tree before killing and cannot pause the parent, so trigger tree termination only after the descendant is known to exist and assert its pid is gone.

Windows can stamp writes within one clock tick identically and reports directory size 0, so same-size rewrites, repeated identical rewrites on retry, and directory entry removals or renames can be invisible to metadata checks.

Wrap every simulated concurrent change in mutateObservably(path, mutate) from test/helpers.ts, passing the parent directory for entry additions, removals and renames. Use restoreTimesWithNewCtime when a test deliberately restores mtime after rewriting.
verification: Enumerate timestamp-dependent tests deterministically: run TMPDIR on an HFS+ disk image (hdiutil create -fs HFS+, 1-second file times) with bun run test:all, plus a throwaway run that ignores directory size in sameStableEntryMetadataExceptCtimeAndMode. Only the HFS+ NFD-locale, hard-link inode and Windows-skipped ctime-only tests may remain.
